title: Optimize ORDER BY limit window sorting
description: Avoid fully sorting all ORDER BY rows when a finite LIMIT/OFFSET window is requested.
convergence_criteria: ORDER BY comparator helper exists; finite LIMIT uses select_nth_unstable_by; ORDER BY scan pushdown disabled; SQL test passes
hints: Keep ORDER BY stable tie behavior by using original row index as tie-breaker in the top-k path.
execution_directives: cargo fmt --check; cargo check --lib; cargo test --test sql_integration test_select_order_by -- --nocapture
findings: Added ORDER BY comparator helpers, retained only OFFSET + LIMIT sorted candidates for finite windows, and fixed ORDER BY limit pushdown correctness.
